evidence_policy: Synthetic boundary fixtures, not human-label calibration or a literary-quality score.

audit.error_analysis: Observed artifact-count-only completion gap; red-green behavioral regressions and private adapter traces.
audit.evaluator_design: Binary behavior assertions; no similarity score or compensating average.
audit.judge_validation: No LLM judge is used; interpretation quality and speaker verification remain unvalidated human review.
audit.human_review: Rendered private Markdown links to source turns; no automated impersonation or approval.
audit.labeled_data: Synthetic tests plus bounded private draft readings. No human-labeled held-out corpus; no TPR/TNR claim.
audit.pipeline_hygiene: Recipe and corpus fingerprints; input drift invalidates completion; independent CI runtime tests.
